title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2024, Section X – European External Action Service
part_text: 10. Calls on the Court to conduct a comprehensive performance audit of the EEAS to evaluate the efficiency of its activities compared to the diplomatic services of OECD countries; requests that this audit identify areas where the EEAS provides added value; insists on the establishment of clear, measurable performance indicators to demonstrate the 'value for money' delivered to Union citizens;
